For this reason, methods that minimize contact between people—such as social isolation, the use of personal protective equipment like masks and gloves, and maintaining social distance—have become highly important in preventing transmission (WHO, 2020b).
discourses.translated_txt: Bu nedenle, insanlar arasındaki teması en aza indiren yöntemler - örneğin sosyal izolasyon, maske ve eldiven gibi kişisel koruyucu ekipmanların kullanımı ve sosyal mesafeyi korumak - bulaşmayı önlemede son derece önemli hale geldi (WHO, 2020b).

discourses.source_txt: Close contact between people, high mobility, public transportation, and shared spaces are factors that cause infections to spread rapidly (Hang, 2020). Studies conducted in China, where the initial cases emerged, determined that human movement within communal living areas needed to be reorganized. Within this scope, schools were closed, people were advised to stay at home, and the use of communal spaces was restricted. These measures proved effective in bringing the number of COVID-19 cases under control (Gu, Jiang, Zhao, & Zheng, 2020; Tian et al., 2020; as cited in Deniz & Evci Kiraz, 2020, p. 148). In Turkey as well, numerous measures were implemented to combat COVID-19, one of which was the suspension of classes in schools. Explaining the measures taken, Minister of National Education Ziya Selçuk announced that weekly lesson schedules would be restructured and that required remedial education support would be provided online through the Education Informatics Network (EBA) and on television through the Turkish Radio and Television Corporation (TRT) (Ministry of National Education [MNE], 2020). Accordingly, conducting classes via distance education during the COVID-19 process became one of the measures taken, and the distance education process began for millions of students and teachers.
discourses.translated_txt: İnsanların yakın teması, yüksek hareketlilik, toplu taşıma ve paylaşılan alanlar, enfeksiyonların hızla yayılmasına neden olan faktörlerdir (Hang, 2020). İlk vakaların ortaya çıktığı Çin'de yapılan çalışmalar, toplumsal yaşam alanlarındaki insan hareketinin yeniden düzenlenmesi gerektiğini belirledi. Bu kapsamda okullar kapatıldı, insanların evde kalması tavsiye edildi ve toplumsal alanların kullanımı kısıtlandı. Bu önlemler COVID-19 vakalarının sayısını kontrol altına almakta etkili oldu (Gu, Jiang, Zhao, & Zheng, 2020; Tian ve diğerleri, 2020; Deniz ve Evci Kiraz, 2020, s. 148'de alıntılandığı gibi). Türkiye'de de, COVID-19 ile mücadele etmek için birçok önlem uygulandı, bunlardan biri okullarda derslerin askıya alınmasıydı. Alınan önlemleri açıklayan Milli Eğitim

discourses.source_txt: Distance education, which provides educational opportunities to large groups of individuals with different physical, social, and economic conditions, can be conducted through various means. The continuously advancing technology has also developed and transformed the tools used in distance education.
discourses.translated_txt: Farklı fiziksel, sosyal ve ekonomik koşullara sahip büyük gruplara eğitim fırsatları sunan uzaktan eğitim, çeşitli yollarla yapılabilir. Sürekli gelişen teknoloji, uzaktan eğitimde kullanılan araçları da geliştirdi ve dönüştürdü.

discourses.source_txt: Starting with printed texts and letters, and extending to programmed texts and textbooks, printed materials have also been delivered through different media as technology has developed.
discourses.translated_txt: Basılı metinler ve mektuplarla başlayarak, programlanmış metinlere ve ders kitaplarına uzanan basılı materyaller, teknoloji geliştikçe farklı medyalar aracılığıyla da teslim edilmiştir.

discourses.source_txt: Distance education can also be conducted using multimedia such as tape recorders, radio, television, films, and presentations, as well as through computer and internet technologies (Alakoç & Bozbıyık, 2003, p. 1195; Hızal, 1983, p. 69; Koçdar, 2006, p. 31; Unusan & Abia, 2007, p. 129). While the use and implementation methods of distance education vary according to available resources, conditions, and needs, in Turkey during the pandemic period, distance education was carried out using television and internet technologies (Ministry of National Education, 2020).
discourses.translated_txt: Uzaktan eğitim, kaset kayıt cihazları, radyo, televizyon, filmler ve sunumlar gibi multimedyaların yanı sıra bilgisayar ve internet teknolojileri aracılığıyla da yapılabilir (Alakoç & Bozbıyık, 2003, s. 1195; Hızal, 1983, s. 69; Koçdar, 2006, s. 31; Unusan & Abia, 2007, s. 129). Uzaktan eğitimin kullanımı ve uygulanma yöntemleri mevcut kaynaklara, koşullara ve ihtiyaçlara göre değişirken, Türkiye'de pandemik dönemi boyunca, uzaktan eğitim televizyon ve internet teknolojileri kullanılarak gerçekleştirilirdi (Ulusal Eğitim Bakanlığı, 2020).

discourses.source_txt: The EBA platform is used effectively, especially for offline education, while EBA TV and the Zoom live lesson software are utilized for online education.
discourses.translated_txt: EBA platformu özellikle çevrimdışı eğitim için etkili bir şekilde kullanılırken, EBA TV ve Zoom canlı ders yazılımı çevrimiçi eğitim için kullanılır.

discourses.source_txt: Distance education, in its most general and simplest definition, is a formal educational process in which students and teachers are not physically in the same place (National Center for Education Statistics [NCES], 2008, p. 1). In the distance education process, students and teachers, while in physically separate environments, connect with instructional resources and with each other through interactive communication technologies (Simonson, Smaldino, Albright, and Zvacek, 2012, p. 10).
discourses.translated_txt: Uzaktan eğitim, en genel ve en basit tanımında, öğrencilerin ve öğretmenlerin fiziksel olarak aynı yerde bulunmadığı resmi bir eğitim sürecidir (Ulusal Eğitim İstatistikleri Merkezi [NCES], 2008, s. 1). Uzaktan eğitim sürecinde, öğrenciler ve öğretmenler, fiziksel olarak ayrı ortamlarda iken, öğretim kaynaklarıyla ve birbirleriyle etkileşimli iletişim teknolojileri aracılığıyla bağlantı kurarlar (Simonson, Smaldino, Albright ve Zvacek, 2012, s. 10).

discourses.source_txt: Conceptually, distance education aims to create new educational opportunities, integrate work and learning, ensure equal opportunity in education, promote lifelong learning, integrate educational technology into the process, provide opportunities for both individual and mass education, and make education effective, efficient, and cost-effective (Alkan, 1998, p. 193; Cavanaugh, 2001, p. 75). Additionally, distance education is an educational method that offers learning opportunities through printed, audiovisual, and electronic materials to learners at times when educational opportunities in formal education institutions are inaccessible or unavailable due to various reasons such as age, illness, geographical distance, family situations, or constraints of time and money (Demiray, 1999, p. 85).
discourses.translated_txt: Fırsatlı eğitim, kavramsal olarak, yeni eğitim fırsatları yaratmayı, çalışma ve öğrenmeyi entegre etmeyi, eğitimde eşit fırsat sağlamayı, ömür boyu öğrenmeyi teşvik etmeyi, eğitim teknolojisini sürece entegre etmeyi, hem bireysel hem de kitlesel eğitim için fırsatlar sağlamayı ve eğitimi etkili, verimli ve uygun maliyetli hale getirmeyi amaçlar (Alkan, 1998, s. 193; Cavanaugh, 2001, s. 75). Ayrıca, mesafe eğitimi, resmi eğitim kurumlarında eğitim fırsatlarının erişilemez veya erişilemez olduğu zamanlarda öğrencilere basılı, görsel ve elektronik materyaller aracılığıyla öğrenme fırsatları sunan bir eğitim yöntemidir. yaş, hastalık, coğrafi mesafe, aile durumları veya zaman ve para kısıtlamaları gibi çeşitli nedenlerden dolayı (Demiray, 1999, s. 85).

discourses.source_txt: Each teaching method has different characteristics of use, and it cannot be claimed that any one method is always suitable, practical, or successful for all students under all conditions.
discourses.translated_txt: Her öğretim yönteminin farklı kullanım özellikleri vardır ve herhangi bir yöntemin her koşulda tüm öğrenciler için her zaman uygun, pratik veya başarılı olduğu iddia edilemez.

discourses.source_txt: When selecting a method, there are variables such as conditions and students that affect the choice of method. While all methods have their own specific advantages and disadvantages, distance education also has many advantages and disadvantages. Especially when compared to face-to-face education, the significant advantages of distance education become evident. Distance education provides access to information for large groups without limitations of time and place. By adding richness and flexibility to educational processes, it allows learners to learn continuously and independently at their own pace. Distance education enables instant and easier access to information through information and communication technologies, reduces educational costs, and offers flexible and objective assessment and evaluation (Elitaş, 2017, p. 94; İşman, 2008, p. 18; Uşun, 2006, p. 19). Of course, as technology is reflected in education and used in conjunction with it, distance education conducted in more advanced forms also brings some disadvantages. Elitaş (2017, p. 95) explained the important disadvantages of distance education as follows: The lack of a group work discipline and the lack of interaction may lead to loss of motivation and cause the learner to become antisocial. It may be inadequate for teaching courses or topics that require practical application. There may be a risk of technology dependence and problems with the reliability of assessment and evaluation.
discourses.translated_txt: Bir yöntem seçerken, koşullar ve öğrenciler gibi değişkenler vardır ki, bu değişkenler yöntem seçimini etkiler. Her yöntemin kendine özgü avantajları ve dezavantajları olsa da, uzaktan eğitimin de birçok avantajı ve dezavantajı vardır. Özellikle yüz yüze eğitimle karşılaştırıldığında, uzaktan eğitimin önemli avantajları belirgin hale gelir. Uzaktan eğitim, zaman ve yer sınırlamaları olmaksızın büyük gruplar için bilgi erişimi sağlar. Eğitim süreçlerine zenginlik ve esneklik ekleyerek, öğrencilerin kendi hızlarında sürekli ve bağımsız olarak öğrenmelerini sağlar. Uzaktan eğitim, bilgi ve iletişim teknolojileri aracılığıyla bilgiye daha kolay erişimi sağlar ve eğitim maliyetlerini azaltır ve esnek ve nesnel değerlendirme ve değerlendirme sunar (Elitaş, 2017, s. 94; İşman, 2008, s. 18; Uşun

discourses.source_txt: The process of distance education, which began with correspondence courses and extends to the advanced software and hardware technologies used today, dates back to the 1700s globally and to the 1900s in our country. In particular, the announcement in the Boston Gazette in 1728 that shorthand lessons would be delivered via distance education is recorded as a significant development, and the publication in 1833 of an advertisement stating that learning would be conducted using letters marked another important step in the field of distance education (Çoban, 2013, p. 2). In Turkey, the initial steps of distance education were taken in 1927 when correspondence education was considered a solution during a period when educational institutions faced physical deficiencies and solutions were sought for general educational problems (Arar, 1999, p. 26). In the 1950s, distance education was encouraged in vocational and foreign language training, and with the establishment of TRT in 1968, efforts were made to utilize television technology in distance education. In 1982, the Open Education Faculty of Anadolu University officially began its services, and in the 1990s, web-based distance education initiatives gained momentum in universities (Çukadar & Çelik, 2003, p. 33; Fiş Erümit, Gedik & Göktaş, 2016, p. 666). In recent years, as Kırık (2016, p. 58) has also noted, distance education has become highly developed in Turkey, and during the COVID-19 period, education was conducted remotely through the EBA platform and EBA TV. Subsequently, in the 2020-2021 academic year, the Ministry of National Education allowed the use of free applications such as Zoom to further support distance education.
discourses.translated_txt: Bugün kullanılan ileri yazılım ve donanım teknolojileriyle yazışma kurslarıyla başlayan ve uzanan uzaktan eğitim süreci, dünya çapında 1700'lere, ülkemizde ise 1900'lere kadar uzanmaktadır. Özellikle Boston Gazetesi'nde 1728'de stenografi derslerinin uzaktan eğitim yoluyla verileceği duyurusu önemli bir gelişme olarak kaydedilmiş ve 1833'te öğrenimin mektuplar yoluyla yapılacağı bildirilen bir reklamın yayınlanması, uzaktan eğitim alanında başka bir önemli adım olarak görülmüştür (Çoban, 2013, s. 2). Importance and Purpose of the Study  
In order to slow the spread of the COVID-19 pandemic, governments at times implemented various restrictions such as curfews and travel bans, and the closure of educational institutions was also among the measures taken. During this period, the educational process was restructured through the distance education system to ensure the continuity of learning for students and to keep the countries’ educational systems active. In the distance education system, where students are at the center, the role of the teacher in creating suitable learning environments for students has become even more significant, especially during this pandemic, which affected the entire world. Teacher roles in facilitating learning processes and guiding students in distance education, as well as their perspectives on distance education and their experiences teaching through this method, are factors that affect the efficiency of the educational process (Harris & Krousgill, 2008, p. 918; Yurdakul, 2015).

The aim of this study is to determine teachers’ opinions regarding the compulsory implementation of distance education in Turkey due to COVID-19 and, based on these opinions, to offer suggestions for increasing the effectiveness of the distance education process. The research problem is stated as follows: “What are teachers’ opinions on the compulsory distance education implemented in Turkey due to COVID-19?” The following sub-problems are addressed:
1) What are teachers’ opinions regarding the delivery of courses conducted through distance education and their impact on learning processes? 2) What are teachers’ views on assessment processes in distance education? 3) What are teachers’ perspectives on their self-perceived competence (needs for in-service training) in conducting courses via distance education? 4) Compared to face-to-face education, what are the positive and negative aspects of distance education? 5) What are teachers’ suggestions for the effective and efficient implementation of the distance education process?

Method
Research Model
The research employs the phenomenological model. In educational research, explaining a phenomenon, thereby attempting to clarify life experiences related to it and evaluating results and variables, is a common practice. Accordingly, qualitative studies are conducted with small groups to obtain in-depth information about people's life situations (Arthur, Waring, Robert, and Hedges, 2017, pp. 10-11). In phenomenological studies, which are defined as the experience of an event or phenomenon by an individual or individuals, it is known that experiencing the phenomenon is of critical importance (Seggie and Bayyurt, 2017, p. 3). In this study, interviews were conducted with teachers who experienced the distance education that was mandatorily implemented during the COVID-19 period, and the situations, deficiencies, advantages, disadvantages, and reflections on students and teachers that occurred during this process were examined. The main purpose here is not to reach generalizations, but rather to describe and explore the situation in question.

Buna göre, insanların yaşam durumları hakkında derinlemesine bilgi edinmek için küçük gruplarla niteliksel çalışmalar yapılır (Arthur, Waring, Robert ve Hedges, 2017, s. 10-11). Validity and Reliability  
Validity and reliability in qualitative studies differ significantly from those in quantitative studies. In qualitative research, explaining the procedures from the beginning to the end of the study, reporting the results in detail, and being objective, flexible, and transparent are considered criteria for validity and reliability (Yıldırım & Şimşek, 2008). Kuş (2008) also states that the use of computer-assisted software in qualitative studies contributes to enhancing validity and reliability by increasing transparency and generalizability. Throughout the research, the procedures and stages were explained in detail, and expert opinions were sought during the development of the data collection tool.
discourses.translated_txt: Kalitatif çalışmalarda geçerlilik ve güvenilirlik, niceliksel çalışmalarda geçerli ve güvenilirlikten önemli ölçüde farklıdır. Niteliksel araştırmada, prosedürleri çalışmanın başlangıcından sonuna kadar açıklamak, sonuçları ayrıntılı olarak raporlamak ve objektif, esnek ve şeffaf olmak geçerlilik ve güvenilirlik kriterleri olarak kabul edilir (Yıldırım ve Şimşek, 2008). Kuş (2008) ayrıca, niteliksel çalışmalarda bilgisayar destekli yazılımların kullanımı, şeffaflık ve genelleştirilebilirliği artırarak geçerliliği ve güvenilirliği artırmaya katkıda bulunduğunu belirtir. Araştırma boyunca, prosedürler ve aşamalar ayrıntılı olarak açıklandı ve veri toplama aracı geliştirildiğinde uzman görüşleri istendi.

discourses.source_txt: The data were subjected to in-depth analysis using qualitative data analysis software, with frequent inclusion of direct quotations in an effort to ensure validity. For internal reliability, inter-coder agreement was calculated. In this calculation, the reliability coefficient formula for qualitative studies proposed by Miles and Huberman (1994, p. 64) was used (reliability = agreement / (agreement + disagreement) x 100). According to Miles and Huberman (1994, p. 64), a minimum reliability of 70% is recommended. In this study, the interview data in written form were coded independently by the researchers, and the codes were reviewed to identify areas of agreement and disagreement. As a result, the inter-coder agreement was calculated to be 83.75%. For external reliability, it is necessary to describe the characteristics of the participants, state the limitations, and discuss the data collection process and analyses (Yıldırım & Şimşek, 2013). These requirements were explained under appropriate headings in the study, and an effort was made to ensure external reliability. Data Collection and Data Collection Tool The data were collected offline in a virtual environment using the interview method—one of the qualitative data collection methods—through a semi-structured interview form. The interviews were conducted in written form.

discourses.source_txt: 8- What can be done to make teaching lessons through distance education more functional during this process? In forming the interview questions, the focus was on the Zoom live lesson software—which provides two-way communication and was used in compulsory distance education during the COVID-19 period—the EBA platform, which is used for asynchronous education, and EBA TV, which offers one-way communication. The aim was to identify the effects of these systems on the learning process, as well as to reveal teachers’ observations regarding the effects of distance education and these systems on students, teachers, and learning itself. The data were collected in the final weeks of the second semester of the 2019-2020 academic year.

Data Analysis  
The content analysis method was used to analyze the data. In content analysis, qualitative data are analyzed in depth and coded; based on these codes, themes are generated, and the items related to these themes are reported with their frequency and percentage values (Sönmez and Alacapınar, 2013, p. 116). During the data analysis, the NVivo 10 software, a qualitative data analysis program, was also utilized. NVivo 10 was specifically employed for coding, generating themes by merging codes, identifying frequently occurring words, constructing models, and conducting other queries.

İçerik analizinde niteliksel veriler derinlemesine analiz edilir ve kodlanır; bu kodlara dayanarak, temalar oluşturulur ve bu temalarla ilgili öğeler, frekans ve yüzde değerleriyle rapor edilir (Sönmez ve Alacapınar, 2013, s. 116). Veri analizi sırasında, niteliksel veri analizi programı olan NVivo 10 yazılımı da kullanılmıştır. NVivo 10 özellikle kodlama, kodları birleştirerek temalar oluşturma, sıklıkla kullanılan kelimeleri tanımlama, modeller oluşturma ve diğer sorguları gerçekleştirmek için kullanılmıştır.

Findings  
As a result of the content analysis, the following themes emerged based on the teachers’ responses: “situations encountered specifically during the COVID-19 period,” “conveniences provided by distance education,” “disadvantages encountered in distance education,” and “needs felt throughout the process.” Each theme and its subthemes were modeled and presented in NVivo along with their frequencies.
discourses.translated_txt: Bulgular İçerik analizi sonucunda, öğretmenlerin yanıtlarına dayanarak aşağıdaki temalar ortaya çıktı: COVID-19 döneminde özellikle karşılaşılan durumlar, Uzaktan Eğitim tarafından sağlanan kolaylıklar, Uzaktan Eğitimde karşılaşılan dezavantajlar ve süreç boyunca hissedilen ihtiyaçlar. Her tema ve alt temalar NVivo'da sıklıklarıyla birlikte modellenmiş ve sunulmuştur.

The differentiation of interaction in distance education restricts the expression of emotions. Both the systemic characteristics of distance education and the lack of synergy found in the classroom are among the reasons for this. Learning is a communication process, and expressing emotions is important in this process. Through effective communication, the level of learning and social relationships can be strengthened. One of the components of communication is feedback. Although some level of feedback can be provided in distance education, this feedback is not as effective as in face-to-face environments. The fact that students and teachers do not see each other in the virtual environment leaves the control of learning more to the student and reduces external stimuli related to learning. Therefore, students’ motivation towards learning may decrease.

Findings Regarding the Question: “Can You Compare Distance Education and Traditional Education in Terms of Advantages and Disadvantages?”
Teachers generally mentioned both the advantages and disadvantages of distance education when compared to face-to-face teaching. However, during the COVID-19 period, when face-to-face education could not be conducted, the next best alternative that could most closely approximate what could be done in a face-to-face environment and ensure the continuity of teaching was, again, distance education. In this respect, although it does not fully replace face-to-face education, teachers stated that the best alternative or solution to face-to-face instruction could be distance education. One of the most significant advantages of distance education, namely independence from time and place, was also felt during this period. In addition, teachers especially emphasized the opportunity in distance education for students to rewatch offline lessons as many times as they wish, particularly highlighting the pause–resume feature of videos.

Discussion and Conclusion  
The compulsory conduct of courses in digital environments has had various repercussions from different perspectives. Although the dominant opinion among teachers is that distance education cannot replace face-to-face education conducted in classroom settings, it is acknowledged that in this extraordinary period where in-person education is not possible, the best solution remains distance education. Sindiani (2020) also stated in his study that distance education was the best option during this process.

discourses.source_txt: In order to reach all students through remote education and ensure that all stakeholders benefit, it is necessary to provide adequate technical infrastructure even in rural areas and to make accessibility possible in terms of both software and hardware.
discourses.translated_txt: Uzaktan eğitim yoluyla tüm öğrencilere ulaşmak ve tüm paydaşların yararlanmasını sağlamak için, kırsal alanlarda bile yeterli teknik altyapı sağlamak ve hem yazılım hem de donanım açısından erişilebilirliği mümkün kılmak gereklidir.

discourses.source_txt: Morgan (2020) and Carrillo and Flores (2020) also found that students without a computer or internet access at home experienced a decline compared to face-to-face education.
discourses.translated_txt: Morgan (2020) ve Carrillo ve Flores (2020) ayrıca evde bilgisayar veya internet erişimi olmayan öğrencilerin yüz yüze eğitimle karşılaştırıldığında bir düşüş yaşadığını buldu.

discourses.source_txt: The provision of internet services and the socio-economic status of families play a role in access to these resources. Differences in access among students lead to unequal opportunities (Bennett, Uink, and Cross, 2020). Indeed, it has been determined that the number of students in our country who were unable to benefit from distance education services during the pandemic was at significant levels, and that this inequality of opportunity reduced the quality of education (Yılmaz, Güner, Mutlu, Doğanay, and Yılmaz, 2020, p. 25).
discourses.translated_txt: İnternet hizmetlerinin sağlanması ve ailelerin sosyo-ekonomik durumu bu kaynaklara erişiminde rol oynamaktadır. Öğrenciler arasındaki erişim farklılıkları eşitsiz fırsatlara yol açmaktadır (Bennett, Uink ve Cross, 2020).

discourses.source_txt: In contrast to these findings, Kang and Zhang (2020) found that online education during this period increased learning levels and motivation.
discourses.translated_txt: Bu bulguların aksine, Kang ve Zhang (2020) bu dönemde çevrimiçi eğitimin öğrenme seviyelerini ve motivasyonunu arttırdığını buldu.

discourses.source_txt: It has been found that teachers' approaches to distance education vary according to their subject area.
discourses.translated_txt: Öğretmenlerin uzaktan eğitim yaklaşımlarının, konu alanlarına göre farklılık gösterdiği tespit edilmiştir.

discourses.source_txt: While teachers of theoretically oriented courses generally find the method sufficient in instruction, teachers of practical courses may find it inadequate.
discourses.translated_txt: Teorik yönlü derslerin öğretmenleri genellikle öğretim için yeterli olan bir yöntem bulurken, pratik derslerin öğretmenleri yetersiz bulabilir.

discourses.source_txt: However, according to the study by Koçoğlu, Ulu Kalın, Tekdal, and Yiğen (2020, p. 2961), teachers found the remote education activities conducted to be sufficient regardless of the subject or educational level.
discourses.translated_txt: Ancak Koçoğlu, Ulu Kalın, Tekdal ve Yiğen (2020, s. 2961) tarafından yapılan çalışmaya göre, öğretmenler, konuya veya eğitim seviyesine bakılmaksızın yürütülen uzaktan eğitim faaliyetlerinin yeterli olduğunu bulmuşlardır.

discourses.source_txt: There have been those who argue that exams should be conducted remotely, those who argue that they should be held face-to-face, and those who argue that there should be no exams at all.
discourses.translated_txt: Sınavların uzaktan yapılmasını savunanlar, yüz yüze yapılmasını savunanlar ve hiç sınav yapılmamasını savunanlar oldu.

discourses.source_txt: However, while traditional face-to-face education tends to emphasize outcomes, during distance education, the activities carried out throughout the process have been highlighted as more important for learning, thus emphasizing the significance of the process itself. It has also been understood that students do not find remote exams reliable or realistic; instead, it has been suggested that assignments to be given throughout the process would be more appropriate than online exams (Kürtüncü & Kurt, 2020, p. 66).
discourses.translated_txt: Bununla birlikte, geleneksel yüz yüze eğitim sonuçları vurgulamaya eğilimli olsa da, uzaktan eğitim sırasında, süreç boyunca yürütülen faaliyetler öğrenme için daha önemli olduğu için vurgulanmıştır, böylece sürecin önemini vurgulamıştır. Ayrıca öğrencilerin uzaktan sınavları güvenilir veya gerçekçi bulmadığı anlaşılmıştır; bunun yerine, süreç boyunca verilen ödevlerin çevrimiçi sınavlardan daha uygun olacağı önerilmiştir (Kürtüncü & Kurt, 2020, s. 66).

discourses.source_txt: Teachers occasionally used the Zoom software for online education; however, following the Ministry’s recommendation due to various security vulnerabilities of Zoom, they stopped using it. Most of those who had used it continued their teaching activities only through the EBA platform and EBA TV.
discourses.translated_txt: Öğretmenler zaman zaman çevrimiçi eğitim için Zoom yazılımını kullanıyordu; ancak, Zoom'un çeşitli güvenlik açıklarından dolayı Bakanlığın önerisini izleyerek, onu kullanmayı bıraktılar.

discourses.source_txt: This situation indicates the need for a reliable live lesson software.
discourses.translated_txt: Bu durum, güvenilir bir canlı ders yazılımına olan ihtiyacı göstermektedir.

discourses.source_txt: Television-based lessons may not meet the needs for online classes. As is well known, live lesson software enables two-way communication and allows for significantly greater interaction.
discourses.translated_txt: Televizyon bazlı dersler, çevrimiçi derslerin ihtiyaçlarını karşılamayabilir.

discourses.source_txt: It has been recognized that there is a need for in-service training regarding the use of distance education systems such as EBA platforms and the teaching of practical lessons through distance education.
discourses.translated_txt: EBA platformları gibi uzaktan eğitim sistemlerinin kullanımı ve uzaktan eğitim yoluyla pratik derslerin verilmesi konusunda hizmet içi eğitime ihtiyaç olduğu kabul edilmiştir.

discourses.source_txt: Kırmızıgül (2020, p. 288) also emphasized the need for in-service training for teachers in his study on this particular process.
discourses.translated_txt: Kırmızıgül (2020, s. 288) bu özel süreçle ilgili çalışmasında öğretmenler için hizmet içi eğitimin gerekliliğini de vurguladı.

discourses.source_txt: Not all teachers took an active role in the very large, student-oriented organization that included approximately 18 million students in primary, secondary, and high schools (Can, 2020, p. 43).
discourses.translated_txt: İlkokul, ortaokul ve lise öğrencilerinden yaklaşık 18 milyon öğrenciyi kapsayan çok büyük, öğrenci odaklı organizasyonda tüm öğretmenler aktif bir rol oynamadı (Can, 2020, s. 43).

discourses.source_txt: Indeed, in distance education, a teacher delivering online lessons to a large number of students does not significantly impact the quality of instruction as it does in face-to-face education. Therefore, in-service training can be provided to teachers gradually, and those who have received such training can be assigned to distance education. It is important that teachers who will be involved in distance education are competent in this field and in areas such as the use of information technologies (Can, 2020, p. 30). The proficiency of teachers in using technologies for distance teaching, students’ access to information tools, and teachers’ in-service training are among the most important factors for the success of the distance education process (König, Jäger-Biela, and Glutsch, 2020).
discourses.translated_txt: Aslında, uzaktan eğitimde, çok sayıda öğrenciye çevrimiçi ders veren bir öğretmenin, yüz yüze eğitimde olduğu gibi öğretim kalitesini önemli ölçüde etkilememesi gerekir. Bu nedenle, öğretmenlere hizmet içi eğitim kademeli olarak sağlanabilir ve bu tür bir eğitim almış olanlar uzaktan eğitime atanılabilir. Uzaktan eğitime katılacak öğretmenlerin bu alanda ve bilgi teknolojilerinin kullanımı gibi alanlarda yetkin olması önemlidir (Can, 2020, s. 30). Uzaktan eğitim için teknolojileri kullanma konusunda öğretmenlerin yeterliliği, öğrencilerin bilgi araçlarına erişimi ve öğretmenlerin hizmet içi eğitimi, uzaktan eğitim sürecinin başarısı için en önemli faktörlerden biridir (König, Jäger-Biela ve Glutsch, 2020).

discourses.source_txt: According to Nuland, Mandzuk, Petrick, and Cooper (2020), teacher training is necessary and important for the use of distance education software and for managing the process successfully.
discourses.translated_txt: Nuland, Mandzuk, Petrick ve Cooper'a (2020) göre, öğretmen eğitimi, uzaktan eğitim yazılımının kullanımı ve sürecin başarılı bir şekilde yönetilmesi için gereklidir ve önemlidir.

discourses.source_txt: While the monitoring of educational tasks assigned to students can be effectively carried out thanks to the strong interaction of face-to-face education, in distance education, the completion of these tasks and extracurricular activities by students is open to abuse. It is difficult to conduct and monitor these activities effectively. Cooperation with parents is of great importance for the effective execution and achievement of these activities, and indeed the entire distance education process.
discourses.translated_txt: Öğrencilere verilen eğitim görevlerinin izlenmesi, yüz yüze eğitiminin güçlü etkileşimi sayesinde etkili bir şekilde gerçekleştirilebilirken, uzaktan eğitimde, öğrencilerin bu görevlerin ve ders dışı faaliyetlerin tamamlanması kötüye kullanıma açıktır. Bu faaliyetleri etkili bir şekilde yürütmek ve izlemek zordur. Bu faaliyetlerin ve hatta tüm uzaktan eğitim sürecinin etkili bir şekilde yürütülmesi ve başarılması için ebeveynlerle işbirliği çok önemlidir.

discourses.source_txt: At this point, the importance of discipline in education and instruction comes to the forefront.
discourses.translated_txt: Bu noktada, eğitim ve talimat alanında disiplinin önemi ön plana çıkar.

discourses.source_txt: Teachers have mentioned various shortcomings regarding the use of distance education in its different aspects.
discourses.translated_txt: Öğretmenler, uzaktan eğitim kullanımı ile ilgili çeşitli eksiklikleri farklı yönlerinde belirttiler.

discourses.source_txt: Tang, Abuhmaid, Olaimat, Oudat, Aldhaeebi, and Bamanger (2020) also reported that the use of distance education alone was generally not satisfactory in terms of class participation, assessment and evaluation, and students’ learning levels.
discourses.translated_txt: Tang, Abuhmaid, Olaimat, Oudat, Aldhaeebi ve Bamanger (2020) ayrıca, sadece uzaktan eğitim kullanımı, sınıf katılım, değerlendirme ve değerlendirme ve öğrencilerin öğrenme seviyeleri açısından genellikle tatmin edici olmadığını bildirdi.

discourses.source_txt: Distance education is necessary and important to be used not only in special situations such as during a pandemic, but at every stage of the educational process. Indeed, while face-to-face education continues, students, teachers, and parents—either intentionally or unintentionally—make use of distance education, whether through social media platforms or by using other tools.
discourses.translated_txt: Uzaktan eğitim, sadece bir pandemik sırasında olduğu gibi özel durumlarda değil, eğitim sürecinin her aşamasında kullanılmak için gereklidir ve önemlidir. Gerçekten de, yüz yüze eğitim devam ederken, öğrenciler, öğretmenler ve ebeveynler - kasıtlı olarak veya kasıtlı olarak - sosyal medya platformları veya diğer araçları kullanarak uzaktan eğitimi kullanırlar.

discourses.source_txt: Even outside the pandemic process, although distance education is used effectively, the continued reliance on face-to-face education has brought blended learning—the combination of these two methods—to the forefront. The Ministry of National Education announced that following the return to face-to-face education after COVID-19, distance education would also continue, and that face-to-face and distance education would be integrated and used together. This decision indicates a desire to take advantage of the benefits offered by distance education. This significant development shows that the situations identified during distance education will remain relevant in subsequent periods of the educational process.
discourses.translated_txt: Pandemik sürecin dışında bile, mesafe eğitimi etkili bir şekilde kullanılıyor olsa da, yüz yüze eğitimde devam eden bağımlılık, karışık öğrenmeyi - bu iki yöntemin kombinasyonunu - ön plana çıkardı. Ulusal Eğitim Bakanlığı, COVID-19'dan sonra yüz yüze eğitime dönüşün ardından, mesafe eğitimin de devam edeceğini ve yüz yüze ve mesafe eğitimin birleştirileceğini ve birlikte kullanılacağını açıkladı. Bu karar, mesafe eğitimi tarafından sunulan faydalardan yararlanmak isteklerini göstermektedir. Bu önemli gelişme, mesafe eğitimi sırasında tespit edilen durumların eğitim sürecinin sonraki dönemlerinde de alakalı kalacağını göstermektedir.

discourses.source_txt: Yılmaz, Güner, Mutlu, Doğanay, and Yılmaz (2020, p. 39) also concluded in their study that rather than using distance education exclusively for teaching and learning, it would be more appropriate to use it as a supplementary tool. Based on the research findings, the following recommendations were developed.
discourses.translated_txt: Yılmaz, Güner, Mutlu, Doğanay ve Yılmaz (2020, s. 39) çalışmalarında, uzaktan eğitimden sadece öğretim ve öğrenme için değil, bir ek araç olarak kullanmanın daha uygun olacağı sonucuna vardılar.

discourses.source_txt: Internet infrastructure can be developed to provide internet service to rural areas as much as possible.
discourses.translated_txt: İnternet altyapısı, kırsal alanlara mümkün olduğunca internet hizmeti sağlamak için geliştirilebilir.

discourses.source_txt: - Student participation can be increased by providing more students with access to computers and the internet. - To obtain more realistic results, the assessment and evaluation process can be extended over time. - Online in-service training seminars can be organized on the use of systems employed in distance education. - The effectiveness of distance education can be enhanced by supporting EBA materials with interactive materials and videos to be prepared for applied courses.
discourses.translated_txt: - Öğrencilerin katılımını, daha fazla öğrencinin bilgisayar ve internet erişimine sahip olması yoluyla artırmak mümkündür. - Daha gerçekçi sonuçlar elde etmek için, değerlendirme ve değerlendirme süreci zamanla genişletilebilir. - Uzak eğitimde kullanılan sistemlerin kullanımı hakkında çevrimiçi eğitim seminerleri düzenlenebilir. - Uzak eğitimin etkinliği, EBA materyallerini uygulamalı dersler için hazırlanacak etkileşimli materyaller ve videolarla destekleyerek artırılabilir.

discourses.source_txt: Measures to increase internet bandwidth can be taken to enable faster use of online and offline environments. In order to provide a safer distance education process, domestic and secure live lesson software can be developed.
discourses.translated_txt: İnternet bant genişliğini artırmak için tedbirler alınarak çevrimiçi ve çevrimdışı ortamların daha hızlı kullanılması mümkün kılınır.
